name: DataGridSkeletonRows
purpose: Table-row loading placeholders for a data-grid body.

guidance.useWhen: Use while grid rows are loading and row-shaped visual placeholders are appropriate.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid representing real data, empty states, errors, or status content with skeleton rows.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use only as transient loading visuals; do not treat skeleton rows as data or status records.

accessibility: Every generated skeleton row is aria-hidden so loading placeholders are excluded from the accessibility tree.
knownLimitations: Loading placeholder rows only; they are aria-hidden and do not represent grid data or status content.
